versions.changelog:
clawvisor 0.9.10

- Documentation updated: SKILL.md expanded with new details about the `lifetime` attribute for task-scoped access, including `"sliding"` support and usage guidelines.
- Guidance added for setting `"lifetime": "sliding"` in long-running workflows to auto-extend task TTL.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

Clawvisor 0.9.9

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify usage of authentication headers for fetching the service catalog (now uses X-Clawvisor-Agent-Token).
- Removed skill-card.md file from the repository.

# Clawvisor v0.9.2 Changelog

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Behavior and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

clawvisor 0.9.1

- Updated policy in policies/google-workspace-safe.yaml
- No user-facing documentation or feature changes in this version

Clawvisor Skill v0.9.0

- Added documentation for the new verification mode field (`verification`) on task scope, supporting `"strict"`, `"lenient"`, or `"off"` for improved intent verification customization.
- Updated task-scoped access setup instructions to document the verification override options.
- No functional changes; documentation update only.

Clawvisor skill version 0.8.14 refines documentation and simplifies initial setup.

- Simplified and clarified setup instructions, assuming Clawvisor is already running with required environment variables.
- Updated sample task to reference Google Calendar instead of iMessage.
- Improved example parameters and descriptions for task-scoped access.
- Streamlined explanatory text and guidance to reduce confusion for new users.
- Removed redundant manual setup and cloud relay encryption steps from the documentation.

clawvisor 0.8.13

- SKILL.md updated with improved examples and clarified guidance for task scoping.
- Task example uses a narrower, more illustrative iMessage workflow.
- Adds clear section on sizing scope to the complexity of each task, with practical examples.
- Standing task and exploratory task approaches are now better documented.
- General documentation reorganization and some language tightened for clarity.

clawvisor 0.8.11

- Expanded documentation to include a link to comprehensive Task & Request Examples for better guidance on scoping and gateway requests.
- No changes to code or configuration—update applies to SKILL.md documentation only.

Clawvisor 0.8.10

- Updated Google Workspace security policy (policies/google-workspace-safe.yaml).
- No visible user-facing changes in the skill documentation or setup instructions.

- Updated version and publication fields in documentation to "dev"
- No functional or feature changes; SKILL.md is the only updated file
- Documentation now reflects the development status for version and published_at fields

clawvisor v0.8.7

- Removed redundant or unused policy files, including those for GitHub read-only, Google Workspace Safe, and iMessage Safe Default.
- Refactored policy structure: Google Workspace Safe policy was modified and is no longer duplicated in multiple locations.
- SKILL.md updated to document the broader, capability-based task scoping, provide detailed examples for iMessage, and add usage of `planned_calls` to optimize intent verification and approval flow.
- Documentation now recommends scoping tasks broadly and clearly in both `purpose` and `expected_use` to avoid mid-task interruptions and verification failures.

**Clawvisor 0.8.2 introduces improved setup, blocking API flows, and default policy templates.**

- Added three prebuilt policy files for read-only and safe-by-default actions: GitHub read-only, Google Workspace safe, and iMessage safe.
- SKILL.md significantly revised to clarify setup—now supports both a guided setup URL (recommended) and manual setup, with new cloud relay and E2E encryption guidance.
- Documented that all `curl` requests should be sent as single-line commands to prevent accidental approval fragmentation.
- Gateway and task creation API endpoints now recommend using `?wait=true` for blocking, single-roundtrip approval flows.
- Updated examples and documentation for improved clarity and safety on task scoping, standing tasks, and chain context verification.
Add long-poll support for task approval (GET /api/tasks/{id}?wait=true); deprecate legacy polling
Fix registry metadata to use standard ClawHub JSON format (requires.env + primaryEnv); add OPENCLAW_HOOKS_URL to README env vars table; generalize architecture diagram
Fix registry metadata: switch to standard JSON format with requires.env and primaryEnv so ClawHub surfaces required credentials correctly; move setup/security guidance into skill body
Add security callout for CLAWVISOR_AGENT_TOKEN; recommend approval-required policies for write actions
Add security callout for CLAWVISOR_AGENT_TOKEN; recommend approval-required policies for write actions
Full skill rewrite: chain context verification, data_origin guidance, standing tasks, authorization model summary, expanded troubleshooting

Updated homepage URL, improved documentation and task flow guidance
Expanded docs: better data_origin guidance, intent verification details, full troubleshooting section, authorization model summary, fixed homepage URL
